import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = Integer.parseInt(sc.nextLine().trim());

        List<Integer> A = Arrays.stream(sc.nextLine().trim().split(" "))
                                .map(Integer::parseInt)
                                .collect(Collectors.toList());
        List<Integer> B = Arrays.stream(sc.nextLine().trim().split(" "))
                                .map(Integer::parseInt)
                                .collect(Collectors.toList());

        List<Integer> A_copy = new ArrayList<>(A);
        List<Integer> B_copy = new ArrayList<>(B);

        int maxWins = max_wins(new ArrayList<>(A), new ArrayList<>(B));
        int maxLosses = max_losses(new ArrayList<>(A), new ArrayList<>(B));

        System.out.println((n - maxLosses) + " " + maxWins);
    }

    static int max_wins(List<Integer> A_list, List<Integer> B_list) {
        int total_wins = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            int opponent = (i + 1) % 3;
            int wins = Math.min(A_list.get(i), B_list.get(opponent));
            A_list.set(i, A_list.get(i) - wins);
            B_list.set(opponent, B_list.get(opponent) - wins);
            total_wins += wins;
        }
        return total_wins;
    }

    static int max_losses(List<Integer> A, List<Integer> B) {
        int[][] move_combinations = { {0, 2}, {1, 0}, {2, 1}, {0, 0}, {1, 1}, {2, 2} };
        List<int[][]> permutations = generatePermutations(move_combinations);
        int max_loss = 0;

        for (int[][] perm : permutations) {
            List<Integer> A_temp = new ArrayList<>(A);
            List<Integer> B_temp = new ArrayList<>(B);
            int[] losses = {0, 0, 0};
            for (int[] move : perm) {
                int loss_amount = Math.min(A_temp.get(move[0]), B_temp.get(move[1]));
                A_temp.set(move[0], A_temp.get(move[0]) - loss_amount);
                B_temp.set(move[1], B_temp.get(move[1]) - loss_amount);
                losses[move[0]] += loss_amount;
            }
            int total_loss = Arrays.stream(losses).sum();
            if (total_loss > max_loss) {
                max_loss = total_loss;
            }
        }
        return max_loss;
    }

    static List<int[][]> generatePermutations(int[][] move_combinations) {
        List<int[][]> perms = new ArrayList<>();
        permute(move_combinations, 0, perms);
        return perms;
    }

    static void permute(int[][] arr, int l, List<int[][]> perms) {
        if (l == arr.length - 1) {
            int[][] copy = new int[arr.length][2];
            for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
                copy[i][0] = arr[i][0];
                copy[i][1] = arr[i][1];
            }
            perms.add(copy);
        } else {
            for (int i = l; i < arr.length; i++) {
                swap(arr, l, i);
                permute(arr, l + 1, perms);
                swap(arr, l, i);
            }
        }
    }

    static void swap(int[][] arr, int i, int j) {
        int[] temp = arr[i];
        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = temp;
    }
}
